text: I am chartering the boat back from Rhea a week at a time. It is humiliating and it works.
It works this week.
I came back for one contract. One. When it is done I am on a plane.
One contract. I will not ask for a second.
You will ask. I am telling you now what the answer is.
Why did you come back at all?
Because Marisol asked me to, and I told her years ago that if she ever asked I would come.
Charter fee is due Monday morning. Not Monday afternoon.
Monday morning.
He was at the fuel dock Monday morning paying for diesel with the charter money.
You are going to lose Okonkwo again and this time he will not come back.
I am not going to ask him for a second contract. I gave him my word on the dock.
You gave me your word about the compressor in the first season. I still think about it.
There is a second wreck on the same permit. Two weeks.
You said you would not ask.
I am not asking. I am describing a wreck.
Vale.
He did it in under a minute. I was counting.
He does not experience it as breaking anything. That is what I cannot explain to people.
I will finish the first wreck. Not the second. And then I am gone, and that is the end of it.
I know. You have never once told me a thing that did not happen.
Do not tell Rhea about the second permit.
I am not lying for you again.
I am not asking you to lie. I am asking you not to volunteer.
Is there a second permit?
Yes.
You went straight to her.
I told you I would not cover for you. Unlike some people I meant it when I said it.
The first wreck is cleared. My flight is at six.
Stay for the second and I will put you on the permit as a partner. Signed, notarised, whatever you want.
My flight is at six.
